categories.main_business_segments: Lens Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a one-stop precision manufacturing solution provider for smart terminals, including smartphones, computers, smart automobiles and cockpits, smart headsets and wearables, humanoid robots, and other intelligent devices. Its business covers structural parts, functional modules, and complete machine assembly using materials such as glass, metal, sapphire, ceramics, plastics, leather, fiberglass, and carbon fiber. The company also provides supporting materials, tooling, production and testing equipment, automation devices, and self-developed industrial internet systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation with core technologies in materials and processes, including advanced processing, product testing, equipment development, new materials, industrial internet, production digitization, and smart manufacturing. It has developed proprietary technologies such as 3D glass and metal structural parts, NFC payment terminals, ultra-thin flexible glass (UTG), TGV through-glass vias, and automated assembly equipment. The company integrates AI, big data, cloud computing, and industrial internet to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lens Technology serves leading global customers in consumer electronics and smart automotive sectors, including Apple, Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, Honor, Google, Meta, Tesla, CATL, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Li Auto, NIO, and BYD. Its products cater to smart phones, AI computers, foldable screens, smart automotive cockpits, smart wearables, humanoid robots, and smart retail terminals. The company targets markets driven by AI acceleration, smart automotive growth, and emerging intelligent device applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and R&D bases in China (Hunan, Shenzhen, Dongguan, Changsha, Xiangtan, Kunshan, Taizhou), as well as overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Vietnam, Mexico, Japan, Singapore, Thailand, and Hong Kong. Overseas operations support global supply chain resilience and customer proximity. Sales are split between domestic China (41.37%) and international markets (58.63%).
categories.supply_chain_position: Lens Technology operates across the entire smart terminal industry supply chain with vertical integration from upstream raw material production (glass, metal, sapphire, ceramics) through midstream manufacturing of structural parts and functional modules, to downstream complete machine assembly and delivery. It also develops and manufactures industrial internet and automation equipment, positioning itself as a full-spectrum solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding global production capacity, deepening vertical integration, and broadening product platforms across consumer electronics, smart automotive, humanoid robots, and AI-enabled devices. It invests heavily in R&D focusing on new materials, foldable screen components, optical waveguides, coating technologies, whole machine design, new energy, robotics, and AI. Lens Technology aims to build data-driven smart factories leveraging AI, big data, and industrial internet to enhance efficiency and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of precision components, functional modules, and assembled smart terminal devices. The company operates on a direct sales model, serving major global customers with customized manufacturing solutions. Additional income streams include government subsidies, investment income, and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lens Technology is a leading player in the smart terminal precision manufacturing industry, holding a strong market position with a comprehensive vertical integration and a broad customer base including top global brands. It competes with other advanced component manufacturers and assembly service providers in consumer electronics and smart automotive sectors. Its technological innovation and scale provide competitive advantages in emerging AI and smart device markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lens Technology achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 69.9 billion, a 28.27% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.62 billion, up 19.94%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 81 billion with a net asset return rate of 7.64%. It has shown consistent growth driven by market recovery, AI integration, and expansion in smart automotive and emerging intelligent device sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lens Technology differentiates itself through its comprehensive vertical integration, advanced proprietary technologies, and strong R&D capabilities. It offers high-precision, innovative materials and manufacturing processes that enhance the aesthetics and functionality of smart terminals. The company’s ability to provide end-to-end solutions from raw materials to complete device assembly, combined with intelligent manufacturing and industrial internet platforms, delivers superior quality, efficiency, and customization to global strategic customers.
